The independent point-audit checks every one of the 19,608 ordered decision nodes against all seven forced labels (137,256 comparisons including self rows), with exact payment scale 60 and minimum IC slack 0; its 924 terminal count rows are also read, and the same complete strategy has SHA-256 d2924549f6ea10bd9a732434bef8145694e2bcbbec471abdef60d8d609687141. It does not prove the dual lower bound for every nonnegative cone point, does not turn the 58-customer W=43, OPT_6=58 construction into the same input, and does not imply the universal six-player half theorem.
